verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents generated clients for its Inference API across the Connect, gRPC and Protobuf ecosystems, in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust and Swift. Users can install these instead of hand-writing HTTP calls, so official SDK-style clients exist. The evidence only covers the Inference API: there are no SDKs for the CKS cluster API or other surfaces, and the Terraform provider is infrastructure-as-code rather than an SDK. missing for 10: official SDKs covering CKS and the broader platform APIs, SDK reference docs or usage examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
